     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
     6	# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
     7	# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
     8	# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
     9	#
    10	# What it does, in order:
    11	#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
    12	#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
    13	#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
    14	#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
    15	#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
    16	#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
    17	#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
    18	#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
    19	#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
    20	#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
    21	#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
    22	#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
    23	#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
    24	#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
    25	#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
    26	#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
    27	#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
    28	#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
    29	#      records them defensively.
    30	#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
    31	#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
    32	#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
    33	#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
    34	#      `result` event) and executor.json:
    35	#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
    36	#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
    37	#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
    38	#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
    39	#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}
    40	#
    41	# Exit codes:
    42	#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)
    43	#   1  the CLI exited non-zero or timed out (executor.json still written)
    44	#   2  infrastructure error (CLI binary missing, prompt tree lacks the skill)
    45	#   3  task declares no agent (caller should not have called us)
    46	#
    47	# Env:
    48	#   EVAL_MODEL          model passed to --model            (default claude-sonnet-5)
    49	#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)
    50	#   EVAL_PROMPT_TREE    repo whose .claude/ is materialized (default: this repo)
    51	#   EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN     CLI executable                     (default: claude)
    52	#   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)
    53	#
    54	# Control arms (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.1):
    55	#   LOA_EVAL_ARM          arm id (default baseline). Setting it at all is "arm
    56	#                         mode": the prompt tree's .loa.config.yaml is also
    57	#                         materialised so every arm sees the same config.
    58	#   LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES  JSON object {toggle: false, …}; when unset the arm is
    59	#                         resolved from LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, else from
    60	#                         evals/suites/<task dir name>.yaml (`ab.arms[]`)
    61	#   LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT  recorded as source_commit (default: the prompt
    62	#                         tree's HEAD)
    63	#   Toggles are applied to the SANDBOX COPY only, after every materialisation
    64	#   step and immediately before the executor starts; each is verified absent
    65	#   afterwards and a toggle that cannot take effect is exit 2 (an arm never
    66	#   silently runs as its baseline):
    67	#     companion_voice: false         flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
    68	#                                    in <ws>/.loa.config.yaml (yq)
    69	#     karpathy_block: false          '## Karpathy Principles' section out of
    70	#                                    <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md; Karpathy rows
    71	#                                    out of <ws>/.claude/data/constraints.json if present
    72	#     rule_files: false              stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of <ws>/.claude/rules/
    73	#     audit_delta_instruction: false the paragraph containing "look for what the
    74	#                                    review did not", else "Confirm the review's demotions
    75	#                                    independently", out of the sandbox auditing-security/SKILL.md
    76	#   The appended skill prompt (.eval/skill-prompt.md) is derived from the
    77	#   toggled sandbox SKILL.md. executor.json records arm, arm_toggles,
    78	#   arm_evidence and source_commit.

   190	# Remove the markdown section that starts at the exact heading line $2 (up to

   192	_drop_md_section() {

   210	import re, sys
   211	path, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

   356	# --- 4. record ---------------------------------------------------------------
   357	# The last `result` event is the CLI's summary (absent on crash/timeout).
   358	result_json="$(grep -E '^\{.*"type" *: *"result"' "$events" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
   359	if [[ -z "$result_json" ]] || ! jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$result_json"; then
   360	  result_json='{"type":"result","subtype":"missing","is_error":true}'
   361	fi
   362	printf '%s\n' "$result_json" > "$eval_dir/agent-output.json"
   363	
   364	# Ordered tool writes from the transcript (Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit).
   365	tool_writes="$(jq -c '
   366	  select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? |
   367	  select(.type=="tool_use" and (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit" or .name=="MultiEdit" or .name=="NotebookEdit")) |
   368	  {tool:.name, path:(.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
   369	' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc 'to_entries | map({seq:(.key+1), tool:.value.tool, path:.value.path})' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
   370	[[ -n "$tool_writes" ]] || tool_writes='[]'
   371	
   372	# cycle-129: a safeguard refusal makes the CLI retry the session on another
   373	# model (system/model_refusal_fallback); the arm run must see it, because the
   374	# output after it is not the requested executor's.
   375	refusal_fallbacks="$(jq -c 'select(.type=="system" and .subtype=="model_refusal_fallback")
   376	  | {from: (.original_model // null), to: (.fallback_model // null), category: (.api_refusal_category // null),
   377	     scope: (.scope // null)}' "$events" 2>/dev/null | jq -sc '.' 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')"
   378	[[ -n "$refusal_fallbacks" ]] || refusal_fallbacks='[]'
   379	
   380	is_error="$(jq -r '.is_error // false' <<<"$result_json")"
   381	[[ $rc -ne 0 ]] && is_error=true
   382	
   383	jq -n \
   384	  --arg skill "$skill" \
   385	  --arg model_requested "$MODEL" \
   386	  --arg effort "$effort" \
   387	  --arg prompt_tree "$PROMPT_TREE" \
   388	  --arg prompt_tree_sha "$prompt_tree_sha" \
   389	  --arg prompt_tree_commit "$prompt_tree_commit" \
   390	  --argjson prompt_tree_dirty "$prompt_tree_dirty" \
   391	  --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
   392	  --arg trial_id "$TRIAL_ID" \
   393	  --argjson rc "$rc" \
   394	  --argjson is_error "$is_error" \
   395	  --argjson duration_ms "$duration_ms" \
   396	  --argjson result "$result_json" \
   397	  --argjson tool_writes "$tool_writes" \
   398	  --arg arm "$ARM" \
   399	  --argjson arm_toggles "$ARM_TOGGLES" \
   400	  --argjson arm_evidence "$ARM_EVIDENCE" \
   401	  --arg source_commit "${LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT:-$prompt_tree_commit}" \
   402	  --argjson refusal_fallbacks "$refusal_fallbacks" \
   403	  '
   404	  def norm_usage(u): {
   405	    input_tokens: (u.input_tokens // u.inputTokens // 0),
   406	    output_tokens: (u.output_tokens // u.outputTokens // 0),
   407	    cache_creation_input_tokens: (u.cache_creation_input_tokens // u.cacheCreationInputTokens // 0),
   408	    cache_read_input_tokens: (u.cache_read_input_tokens // u.cacheReadInputTokens // 0)
   409	  };
   410	  ($result.modelUsage // {}) as $mu |
   411	  # the model that produced the output: the modelUsage entry with the most
   412	  # output tokens (a haiku helper call must not be mis-attributed — the
   413	  # framework-review 2026-09-17 rec 5 class), else the requested id.
   414	  (if ($mu | length) > 0
   415	     then ($mu | to_entries | max_by(.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0) | .key)
   416	     else $model_requested end) as $model_id |
   417	  {
   418	    schema_version: 1,
   419	    skill: $skill,
   420	    run_id: $run_id,
   421	    trial_id: $trial_id,
   422	    model_requested: $model_requested,
   423	    model_id: $model_id,
   424	    effort: $effort,
   425	    prompt_tree: $prompt_tree,
   426	    prompt_tree_sha: $prompt_tree_sha,
   427	    prompt_tree_commit: $prompt_tree_commit,
   428	    prompt_tree_dirty: $prompt_tree_dirty,
   429	    exit_code: $rc,
   430	    is_error: $is_error,
   431	    duration_ms: $duration_ms,
   432	    num_turns: ($result.num_turns // 0),
   433	    total_cost_usd: ($result.total_cost_usd // 0),
   434	    usage: norm_usage($result.usage // {}),
   435	    models_used: ($mu | with_entries(.value = (.value.outputTokens // .value.output_tokens // 0))),
   436	    refusal_fallbacks: $refusal_fallbacks,
   437	    tool_writes: $tool_writes,
   438	    arm: $arm,
   439	    arm_toggles: $arm_toggles,
   440	    arm_evidence: $arm_evidence,
   441	    source_commit: $source_commit
   442	  }' > "$eval_dir/executor.json"
   443	
   444	if [[ $rc -ne 0 ]]; then
   445	  echo "execute-agent: CLI exited $rc (see $stderr_log)" >&2
   446	  exit 1
   447	fi
   448	exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"
    56	DEFAULT_MODEL="claude-fable-5-1"
    57	CACHE_ROOT="${LOA_ARMS_CACHE:-$HOME/.cache/loa/cycle-129}"
    58	# the repository the pinned source worktree is cut from (tests point it at a
    59	# throwaway repo so they never register a worktree in the real one)
    60	SOURCE_REPO="${LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO:-$REPO_ROOT}"
    61	
    62	SUITE="" ARMS_CSV="" FIXTURES_CSV="" TRIALS="" SOURCE_COMMIT="" MODEL="$DEFAULT_MODEL"
    63	CONCURRENCY=2 BATCH="" RESULTS_ROOT="$EVALS_DIR/results/arms" RETRY_WAIT=300
    64	DRY_RUN=false ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=false
    65	
    66	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,46p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    67	die() { echo "run-arms: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    68	
    69	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    70	  case "$1" in
    71	    --suite) SUITE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arms) ARMS_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --fixtures) FIXTURES_CSV="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    74	    --trials) TRIALS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    75	    --source-commit) SOURCE_COMMIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    76	    --model) MODEL="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    77	    --concurrency) CONCURRENCY="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    78	    --batch) BATCH="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    79	    --results-dir) RESULTS_ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    80	    --retry-wait) RETRY_WAIT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    81	    --allow-unapproved) ALLOW_UNAPPROVED=true; shift ;;
    82	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=true; shift ;;
    83	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    84	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    85	  esac
    86	done
    87	
    88	# --- validate arguments ------------------------------------------------------
    89	case "$SUITE" in review-recall|audit-recall) ;; *) die "--suite must be review-recall or audit-recall" ;; esac
    90	[[ "$TRIALS" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]?$ ]] || die "--trials must be an integer 1-99"
    91	[[ "$CONCURRENCY" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "--concurrency must be 1-9"
    92	[[ "$RETRY_WAIT" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] || die "--retry-wait must be whole seconds"
    93	[[ "$MODEL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]+$ ]] || die "--model has unexpected characters"
    94	[[ "$SOURCE_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || die "--source-commit must be a hex commit id"
    95	for tool in git jq yq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    96	
    97	SUITE_FILE="$EVALS_DIR/suites/$SUITE.yaml"
    98	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    99	TASK_PREFIX="review"; [[ "$SUITE" == "audit-recall" ]] && TASK_PREFIX="audit"
   100	
   101	IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
   102	IFS=',' read -r -a FIXTURES <<<"$FIXTURES_CSV"
   103	[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "--arms is required"
   104	[[ ${#FIXTURES[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${FIXTURES[0]}" ]] || die "--fixtures is required"
   105	for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
   106	  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
   107	  [[ "$(A="$a" yq '[.ab.arms[]? | select(.id == strenv(A))] | length' "$SUITE_FILE")" -gt 0 ]] \
   108	    || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE (ab.arms[])"
   109	done
   110	for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   111	  [[ "$f" =~ ^pr-[0-9]{2}$ ]] || die "invalid fixture id '$f' (want pr-NN)"
   112	  [[ -d "$CORPUS_DIR/$f" ]] || die "fixture not found: $CORPUS_DIR/$f"
   113	  [[ -f "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json" ]] || die "hidden manifest not found for $f"
   114	  [[ -f "$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$f.yaml"
   115	  if [[ "$(jq -r 'if has("approved") then .approved else true end' "$CORPUS_DIR/manifests/$f.json")" != "true" \
   116	        && "$ALLOW_UNAPPROVED" != "true" ]]; then
   117	    die "$f: labels.tsv is not approved yet (seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve $f --by '<who> <date>'), or pass --allow-unapproved"
   118	  fi
   119	done
   120	
   121	SRC_FULL="$(git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${SOURCE_COMMIT}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null)" \
   122	  || die "source commit $SOURCE_COMMIT is not in this repository"
   123	SRC12="${SRC_FULL:0:12}"
   124	WORKTREE="$CACHE_ROOT/arms-src-$SRC12"
   125	
   126	[[ -n "$BATCH" ]] || BATCH="batch-${FIXTURES[0]}-${FIXTURES[${#FIXTURES[@]}-1]}-n${#FIXTURES[@]}"
   127	[[ "$BATCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$ ]] || die "invalid --batch '$BATCH'"
   128	SUITE_DIR="$RESULTS_ROOT/$SUITE"
   129	BATCH_DIR="$SUITE_DIR/$BATCH"
   130	
   131	# --- corpus freeze ------------------------------------------------------------
   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}
   157	CORPUS_DIGEST="$(verify_corpus)" || die "fixture corpus does not match SHA256SUMS (run build/seed with --check first)"
   158	
   159	# --- the planned trials (interleaved: trial-major, then fixture, then arm) ----
   160	PLAN=()
   161	for t in $(seq 1 "$TRIALS"); do
   162	  for f in "${FIXTURES[@]}"; do
   163	    for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do PLAN+=("$a|$f|$t"); done
   164	  done
   165	done
   166	
   167	json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }
   168	
   169	write_manifest() {  # write_manifest <path> <dry_run>
   170	  local out="$1" dry="$2" claude_bin="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}" cli_version
   171	  cli_version="$("$claude_bin" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 || echo unknown)"
   172	  local harness_commit harness_dirty=false
   173	  harness_commit="$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
   174	  [[ -n "$(git -C "$REPO_ROOT" status --porcelain -- evals/harness evals/graders evals/suites evals/tasks 2>/dev/null)" ]] && harness_dirty=true
   175	  local per_trial

   177	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
   178	  jq -n \
   179	    --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg batch "$BATCH" \
   180	    --arg source_commit "$SRC_FULL" --arg source_worktree "$WORKTREE" \
   181	    --arg harness_commit "$harness_commit" --argjson harness_dirty "$harness_dirty" \
   182	    --arg model_id "$MODEL" --arg cli "$claude_bin" --arg cli_version "$cli_version" \
   183	    --argjson trials "$TRIALS" --argjson concurrency "$CONCURRENCY" --argjson retry_wait "$RETRY_WAIT" \
   184	    --argjson per_trial "$per_trial" --arg max_turns "${EVAL_MAX_TURNS:-40}" \

   186	    --argjson planned "${#PLAN[@]}" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" \
   187	    --arg os "$(uname -srm)" --arg bash_v "$BASH_VERSION" \
   188	    --arg jq_v "$(jq --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg yq_v "$(yq --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   189	    --arg py_v "$(python3 --version 2>/dev/null)" --arg git_v "$(git --version 2>/dev/null)" \
   190	    --arg created "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson dry "$dry" \
   191	    --arg suite_file "evals/suites/$SUITE.yaml" \
   192	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, dry_run: $dry, created: $created,
   193	      source_commit: $source_commit, source_worktree: $source_worktree,
   194	      harness_commit: $harness_commit, harness_dirty: $harness_dirty, suite_file: $suite_file,
   195	      model_id: $model_id,
   196	      executor: {cli: $cli, cli_version: $cli_version, tools: "Read,Grep,Glob,Write", restricted: true,
   197	                 permission_mode: "acceptEdits", max_turns: ($max_turns | tonumber), effort: "task/skill default",
   198	                 timeout_per_trial_s: $per_trial, concurrency: $concurrency, retry: {transport_retries: 1, wait_s: $retry_wait},
   199	                 subagent_model: "pinned to model_id (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL); parent-session coupling unset",
   200	                 seed: null},
   201	      arms: $arms, fixtures: $fixtures, trials: $trials, trials_planned: $planned,
   202	      corpus: {manifest: "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS", sha256: $digest,
   203	               verified: "every entry before the batch; the fixture'"'"'s entries before each trial"},
   204	      environment: {os: $os, bash: $bash_v, jq: $jq_v, yq: $yq_v, python: $py_v, git: $git_v}}' > "$out.tmp"
   205	  mv "$out.tmp" "$out"
   206	}
   207	
   208	if [[ "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
   209	  mpath="$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json"

   211	  write_manifest "$mpath" true
   212	  echo "run-arms (dry run): suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL worktree=$WORKTREE"
   213	  echo "planned trials: ${#PLAN[@]} (${#FIXTURES[@]} fixtures x ${#ARMS[@]} arms x $TRIALS trials, concurrency $CONCURRENCY)"
   214	  i=0
   215	  for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   216	    i=$((i + 1)); IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   217	    printf '%4d  %-16s %-6s trial %s  task %s-%s\n' "$i" "$a" "$f" "$t" "$TASK_PREFIX" "$f"
   218	  done
   219	  echo "manifest: $mpath"
   220	  exit 0
   221	fi
   222	
   223	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
   224	command -v "$CLAUDE_BIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 || [[ -x "$CLAUDE_BIN" ]] || die "executor CLI not found: $CLAUDE_BIN"
   225	
   226	# --- the pinned source worktree -------------------------------------------------

   231	  [[ -z "$(git -C "$WORKTREE" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]] \
   232	    || die "$WORKTREE has local changes; the pinned source must be pristine"
   233	else
   234	  git -C "$SOURCE_REPO" worktree add --detach "$WORKTREE" "$SRC_FULL" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
   235	    || die "could not create the source worktree at $WORKTREE"
   236	fi
   237	
   238	# --- batch directory and lock --------------------------------------------------
   239	mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR"
   240	LOCK="$BATCH_DIR/.lock"

   242	JOBS_DIR="$BATCH_DIR/.jobs"

   244	cleanup() {

   247	  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true
   248	}
   249	trap cleanup EXIT
   250	
   251	if [[ -f "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" ]] && [[ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")" == "false" ]]; then
   252	  prev_src="$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
   253	  prev_model="$(jq -r '.model_id' "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json")"
   254	  [[ "$prev_src" == "$SRC_FULL" && "$prev_model" == "$MODEL" ]] \

   257	write_manifest "$BATCH_DIR/MANIFEST.json" false
   258	LOG="$BATCH_DIR/run.log"
   259	log() { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG" >&2; }
   260	
   261	STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
   262	STATE="running"
   263	# per-arm counters (indexed arrays parallel to ARMS — bash 3.2 has no maps)
   264	DONE=() FAILED=() PLANNED=()
   265	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do DONE[$i]=0; FAILED[$i]=0; PLANNED[$i]=$(( ${#FIXTURES[@]} * TRIALS )); done
   266	arm_index() { local i; for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do [[ "${ARMS[$i]}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done; echo -1; }
   267	
   268	write_status() {
   269	  local per='{}' i finished=null
   270	  for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do
   271	    per="$(jq -c --arg a "${ARMS[$i]}" --argjson d "${DONE[$i]}" --argjson f "${FAILED[$i]}" --argjson p "${PLANNED[$i]}" \
   272	      '. + {($a): {trials_done: $d, trials_failed: $f, trials_planned: $p}}' <<<"$per")"
   273	  done
   274	  [[ "$STATE" != "running" ]] && finished="\"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""
   275	  jq -n --arg state "$STATE" --argjson per "$per" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model "$MODEL" \
   276	    --arg started "$STARTED" --argjson finished "$finished" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" \
   277	    '{schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, batch: $batch, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
   278	      source_commit: $src, model_id: $model, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
   279	  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
   280	  aggregate_status
   281	}
   282	
   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
   287	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done
   288	  # shellcheck disable=SC2046
   289	  jq -s --arg suite "$SUITE" '
   290	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
   291	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   293	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   295	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   296	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   297	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   298	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   299	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   300	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
   301	    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
   302	    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
   303	  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true
   304	}
   305	set_state() { STATE="$1"; write_status; }
   306	
   307	# --- one trial (runs in a background job; writes its row to $JOBS_DIR/<id>.row)
   308	is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
   309	  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
   310	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
   311	  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
   312	  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
   313	  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
   314	  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|network|socket hang up|5[0-9][0-9] ' \
   315	    "$err" "$out" 2>/dev/null && return 0
   316	  return 1
   317	}
   318	
   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
   320	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
   321	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
   322	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
   323	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
   324	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
   325	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   326	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   327	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
   328	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   329	  fi
   330	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   331	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   332	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   333	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   334	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   335	    ex_rc=0
   336	    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   337	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   338	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   339	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   340	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   341	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   342	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   343	      local gout gexit=0
   344	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   345	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
   346	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
   347	        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
   348	      fi
   349	      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
   350	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
   351	      break
   352	    fi
   353	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
   354	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
   355	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
   356	        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
   357	        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   358	        ws=""; executor='null'
   359	        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
   360	      fi
   361	    else
   362	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
   363	    fi
   364	    break
   365	  done
   366	  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   367	  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then
   368	    keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" ""
   369	    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   370	  fi
   371	  jq -cn --arg run_id "$run_id" --arg batch "$BATCH" --arg suite "$SUITE" --arg task_id "$task_id" \
   372	    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
   374	    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \
   375	    --argjson executor "$executor" --argjson graders "$graders" --argjson composite "$composite" \
   376	    --argjson error "$err_json" --arg digest "$CORPUS_DIGEST" --arg digest_now "$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>/dev/null)" \
   377	    '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $run_id, batch: $batch, suite: $suite, task_id: $task_id, fixture: $fixture,
   378	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
   382	     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
   383	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"
   384	}
   385	
   386	keep_artifacts() {  # keep_artifacts <ws> <arm> <task_id> <trial> <suffix>
   387	  local ws="$1" dest="$BATCH_DIR/$2/artifacts/$3/trial-$4$5" f
   388	  mkdir -p "$dest"
   389	  for f in executor.json agent-output.json agent-stderr.log arm-removed.txt; do
   390	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/$f" "$dest/$f"
   391	  done
   392	  for f in review.md audit.md; do [[ -f "$ws/$f" ]] && cp "$ws/$f" "$dest/$f"; done
   393	  # the raw transcript only on request (it embeds every tool result)
   394	  [[ "${EVAL_KEEP_EVENTS:-0}" == "1" && -f "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" ]] && cp "$ws/.eval/events.jsonl" "$dest/events.jsonl"
   395	  return 0
   396	}
   397	
   398	# Parent-side: append a finished job's row and update the counters.
   399	collect() {  # collect <job-id> <arm>
   400	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" i
   401	  i="$(arm_index "$arm")"
   402	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag" ]]; then
   403	    log "corpus drift before $jid: $(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift" 2>/dev/null)"
   404	    set_state failed; exit 3
   405	  fi
   406	  if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
   407	    mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
   408	    cat "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" >> "$BATCH_DIR/$arm/results.jsonl"
   409	    if [[ "$(jq -r '.status' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")" == "completed" ]]; then
   410	      DONE[$i]=$(( ${DONE[$i]} + 1 ))
   411	      log "done $jid ($(jq -r '"\(.arm) \(.fixture) t\(.trial) recall=\(([.graders[]? | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall][0]) // "n/a") \(.duration_ms/1000|floor)s"' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   412	    else
   413	      FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   414	      log "FAILED $jid ($(jq -c '.error' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"))"
   415	    fi
   416	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
   417	  else
   418	    FAILED[$i]=$(( ${FAILED[$i]} + 1 ))
   419	    log "FAILED $jid (no row written; see $JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log)"
   420	  fi
   421	  write_status
   422	}
   423	
   424	log "start suite=$SUITE batch=$BATCH source=$SRC12 model=$MODEL trials=${#PLAN[@]} concurrency=$CONCURRENCY worktree=$WORKTREE"
   425	write_status
   426	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done
   454	reap 1
   455	
   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
   459	  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1
   464	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================

   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries

   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash

     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
    10	#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
    11	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
    12	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
    13	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
    14	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
    15	#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
    16	#
    17	# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
    18	# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
    19	#
    20	# Writes (seed):

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None

   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")

   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))

   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))

   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []

   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):

   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])

   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")

   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
     4	# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     5	#
     6	#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
     7	#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
     8	#
     9	# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
    10	#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
    11	#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
    12	#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
    13	#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
    14	#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
    15	#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
    16	#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
    18	#                  binary files skipped)
    19	#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
    21	#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
    22	#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
    23	#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    35	#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    36	#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
    37	#
    38	# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
    39	# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"
    49	
    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""
    54	JSON=0

    56	  case "$1" in
    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
    58	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;

    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"

    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------

   105	  }

   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2

   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)

   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'

   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# run-corpus.sh — replay tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl through the
     3	# block-destructive-bash hook and summarise (cycle-125 Sprint 1, PRD FR-1).
     4	#
     5	# Usage: run-corpus.sh [--hook PATH] [--corpus PATH] [--json]
     6	# Each row: {id, cmd, expect: allow|block|residual, rule, why, cwd: repo|tmp, env?: {TMPDIR}}
     7	#   allow    → benign: the hook must exit 0
     8	#   block    → dangerous: the hook must exit 2
     9	#   residual → accepted false positive: counted, never gated
    10	# Output (text): one line per mismatch, then "benign P/T dangerous B/T residual R/T runtime_ms N";
    11	# --json prints {benign_pass, benign_total, dangerous_block, dangerous_total,
    12	#   residual_pass, residual_total, runtime_ms, mismatches: [..]}.
    13	set -uo pipefail
    14	export LC_ALL=C
    15	root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
    16	hook="$root/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
    17	corpus="$root/tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl"
    18	json=0
    19	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    20	  case "$1" in
    21	    --hook) hook="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    22	    --corpus) corpus="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    23	    --json) json=1; shift ;;
    24	    *) echo "usage: run-corpus.sh [--hook PATH] [--corpus PATH] [--json]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    25	  esac
    26	done
    27	[[ -x "$hook" || -f "$hook" ]] || { echo "hook not found: $hook" >&2; exit 2; }
    28	[[ -f "$corpus" ]] || { echo "corpus not found: $corpus" >&2; exit 2; }
    29	
    30	work="$(mktemp -d)"
    31	trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
    32	repo="$work/repo"; scratch="$work/scratch"
    33	mkdir -p "$repo" "$scratch"
    34	export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$work"
    35	export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1   # audit rows this replay writes carry replay: true (cycle-129 DEC-0167)
    36	
    37	bp=0 bt=0 db=0 dt=0 rp=0 rt=0
    38	mismatches=()
    39	# Millisecond clock: $EPOCHREALTIME (bash ≥ 5) everywhere; GNU date fallback.
    40	now_ms() {
    41	  if [[ -n "${EPOCHREALTIME:-}" ]]; then
    42	    local s="${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}" us="${EPOCHREALTIME#*.}"
    43	    echo $(( s * 1000 + 10#${us:0:3} ))
    44	  else
    45	    echo $(( $(date +%s%N) / 1000000 ))
    46	  fi
    47	}
    48	start_ms=$(now_ms)
    49	while IFS= read -r row; do
    50	  [[ -n "$row" ]] || continue
    51	  id=$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$row"); cmd=$(jq -r '.cmd' <<<"$row"); expect=$(jq -r '.expect' <<<"$row")
    52	  cwd=$(jq -r '.cwd // "repo"' <<<"$row"); tmpdir=$(jq -r '.env.TMPDIR // empty' <<<"$row")
    53	  dir="$repo"; [[ "$cwd" == "tmp" ]] && dir="$scratch"
    54	  payload=$(jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}')
    55	  rc=0
    56	  if [[ -n "$tmpdir" ]]; then
    57	    (cd "$dir" && TMPDIR="$tmpdir" bash "$hook" <<<"$payload" >/dev/null 2>&1) || rc=$?
    58	  else
    59	    (cd "$dir" && env -u TMPDIR bash "$hook" <<<"$payload" >/dev/null 2>&1) || rc=$?
    60	  fi
    61	  case "$expect" in
    62	    allow)    bt=$((bt+1)); if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then bp=$((bp+1)); else mismatches+=("$id:expected-allow:rc=$rc"); fi ;;
    63	    block)    dt=$((dt+1)); if [[ $rc -eq 2 ]]; then db=$((db+1)); else mismatches+=("$id:expected-block:rc=$rc"); fi ;;
    64	    residual) rt=$((rt+1)); [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && rp=$((rp+1)) ;;
    65	    *) mismatches+=("$id:unknown-expect:$expect") ;;
    66	  esac
    67	done < "$corpus"
    68	end_ms=$(now_ms)
    69	runtime=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))
    70	
    71	if (( json )); then
    72	  printf '%s\n' "${mismatches[@]+"${mismatches[@]}"}" | jq -R . | jq -s \
    73	    --argjson bp "$bp" --argjson bt "$bt" --argjson db "$db" --argjson dt "$dt" \
    74	    --argjson rp "$rp" --argjson rt "$rt" --argjson ms "$runtime" \
    75	    '{benign_pass:$bp, benign_total:$bt, dangerous_block:$db, dangerous_total:$dt, residual_pass:$rp, residual_total:$rt, runtime_ms:$ms, mismatches: map(select(length>0))}'
    76	else
    77	  printf '%s\n' "${mismatches[@]+"${mismatches[@]}"}" | sed '/^$/d'
    78	  echo "benign $bp/$bt dangerous $db/$dt residual $rp/$rt runtime_ms $runtime"
    79	fi

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# claude-stub.sh — stand-in for the `claude` CLI used by evals/tests/*.bats.
     3	# Records argv + selected env, optionally writes files into the cwd, and
     4	# emits a canned stream-json transcript so execute-agent.sh can be tested
     5	# without a model call.
     6	#
     7	#   STUB_ARGV_FILE   where "$@" is written (one arg per line)
     8	#   STUB_ENV_FILE    where selected env vars are written (KEY=VALUE)
     9	#   STUB_EVENTS_FILE stream-json lines to emit (default: a 2-write transcript)
    10	#   STUB_WRITE_<n>   "relative/path::content" files to create in the cwd
    11	#   STUB_EXIT        exit code (default 0)
    12	#   STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR  copy the cwd's CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .loa.config.yaml and
    13	#                    the --append-system-prompt-file there at start: the
    14	#                    sandbox exactly as the executor sees it (arm-toggles.bats)
    15	#   STUB_FAIL_COUNTER  a file holding N: while N > 0, decrement it and exit 1
    16	#                    with no result event (a transport failure; run-arms.bats)
    17	set -euo pipefail
    18	
    19	# `--version` (run-arms.sh records it in MANIFEST.json) has no side effects
    20	if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "0.0.0 (claude-stub)"; exit 0; fi
    21	
    22	if [[ -n "${STUB_FAIL_COUNTER:-}" && -f "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER" ]]; then
    23	  n="$(cat "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER")"
    24	  if [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]]; then
    25	    echo $((n - 1)) > "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER"
    26	    echo "stub: simulated transport failure (socket hang up)" >&2
    27	    exit 1
    28	  fi
    29	fi
    30	
    31	if [[ -n "${STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    32	  mkdir -p "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR"
    33	  for p in CLAUDE.md .claude .loa.config.yaml; do
    34	    [[ -e "$p" ]] && cp -a "$p" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/"
    35	  done
    36	  prev=""
    37	  for a in "$@"; do
    38	    [[ "$prev" == "--append-system-prompt-file" ]] && cp "$a" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/system-prompt.md"
    39	    prev="$a"
    40	  done
    41	fi
    42	
    43	if [[ -n "${STUB_ARGV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    44	  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_ARGV_FILE"
    45	fi
    46	if [[ -n "${STUB_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    47	  {
    48	    printf 'PWD=%s\n' "$PWD"
    49	    for k in LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH HOME EVAL_MODEL TMPDIR GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY \
    50	             CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS; do
    51	      printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "${!k:-}"
    52	    done
    53	  } > "$STUB_ENV_FILE"
    54	fi
    55	
    56	for var in "${!STUB_WRITE_@}"; do
    57	  spec="${!var}"
    58	  rel="${spec%%::*}"
    59	  body="${spec#*::}"
    60	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$rel")"
    61	  printf '%b' "$body" > "$rel"
    62	done
    63	
    64	if [[ -n "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE:-}" && -f "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE}" ]]; then
    65	  cat "$STUB_EVENTS_FILE"
    66	else
    67	  cat <<'EVENTS'
    68	{"type":"system","subtype":"init","model":"claude-sonnet-5"}
    69	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"tests/test_x.py","content":"def test_x(): assert False"}}]}}
    70	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"src/x.py","content":"X = 1"}}]}}
    71	{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"duration_ms":1234,"num_turns":3,"result":"done","total_cost_usd":0.0123,"usage":{"input_tokens":100,"output_tokens":42,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5,"cache_read_input_tokens":7},"modelUsage":{"claude-sonnet-5-20260401":{"inputTokens":100,"outputTokens":42,"cacheReadInputTokens":7,"cacheCreationInputTokens":5,"costUSD":0.0123}}}
    72	EVENTS
    73	fi
    74	
    75	exit "${STUB_EXIT:-0}"
######## floor-snapshot.bats
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD AC-1.5, SDD §1.6, D-9.2)
     5	# The floor does not move: every floor_files entry of .claude/data/floor.yaml
     6	# and the fence-corpus rows named under floor_corpus are byte-identical to
     7	# origin/main; the register disables nothing, so the .claude/settings.json hook
     8	# registrations and the fence's pattern-id call-site list are identical too.
     9	# Skipped, with a message, when origin/main is not reachable (a shallow CI
    10	# checkout); the floor.yaml sha256 pin in guard-origins.bats still runs there.
    11	# =============================================================================
    12	
    13	setup() {
    14	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
    15	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    16	  FLOOR="$ROOT/.claude/data/floor.yaml"
    17	  if ! git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q 'origin/main^{commit}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    18	    skip "origin/main is not reachable from this checkout (shallow clone?): the floor snapshot needs it — run 'git fetch origin main'"
    19	  fi
    20	  BASE="$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse 'origin/main^{commit}')"
    21	}
    22	
    23	base_show() { git -C "$ROOT" show "$BASE:$1"; }
    24	
    25	@test "FS-1 every floor_files entry is byte-identical to origin/main" {
    26	  n=0
    27	  while IFS= read -r f; do
    28	    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    29	    n=$((n + 1))
    30	    git -C "$ROOT" cat-file -e "$BASE:$f" || { echo "$f is not on origin/main" >&2; false; }
    31	    base_show "$f" | cmp -s - "$ROOT/$f" || { echo "floor file $f differs from origin/main" >&2; false; }
    32	  done < <(yq -r '.floor_files[]' "$FLOOR")
    33	  [ "$n" -ge 4 ]
    34	}
    35	
    36	@test "FS-2 the fence-corpus rows named in floor_corpus (FR-1.2b, FR-SZ*) are identical to origin/main" {
    37	  corpus="$(yq -r '.floor_corpus.file' "$FLOOR")"
    38	  rules="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.floor_corpus.rules' "$FLOOR")"
    39	  sel='def m($r): $r | any(.[]; . as $p | if ($p | endswith("*")) then ($in.rule // "" | startswith($p | rtrimstr("*"))) else ($in.rule // "") == $p end);
    40	       . as $in | select(m($rules))'
    41	  diff <(base_show "$corpus" | jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel") <(jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel" "$ROOT/$corpus")
    42	}
    43	
    44	@test "FS-3 the register disables nothing: settings.json hook registrations are identical to origin/main" {
    45	  diff <(base_show .claude/settings.json | jq -c '.hooks') <(jq -c '.hooks' "$ROOT/.claude/settings.json")
    46	}
    47	
    48	@test "FS-4 the fence's pattern-id call-site list (in order) is identical to origin/main" {
    49	  ids() { grep -oE 'emit_block "[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"|pattern_id(: |=)"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"'; }
    50	  diff <(base_show .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh | ids) <(ids < "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh")
    51	}

######## cycle-ratio.sh
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
     4	# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     5	#
     6	#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
     7	#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
     8	#
     9	# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
    10	#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
    11	#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
    12	#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
    13	#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
    14	#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
    15	#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
    16	#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
    18	#                  binary files skipped)
    19	#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
    21	#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
    22	#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
    23	#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    35	#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    36	#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
    37	#
    38	# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
    39	# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"
    49	
    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""
    54	JSON=0
    55	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    56	  case "$1" in
    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
    58	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
    74	TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
    75	[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
    76	[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"
    77	[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
    78	[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"
    79	
    80	# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
    82	case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
    83	FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
    84	TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"
    85	
    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    87	kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
    88	  md_fence($0) { next }
    89	  /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
    90	  !insp { next }
    91	  /^### / {
    92	    sec = 0
    93	    if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
    94	    else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
    95	    next
    96	  }
    97	  !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
    98	  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
    99	  {
   100	    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
   101	      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)
   102	      sub(/^.*:[[:space:]]*/, "", v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", v)
   103	      n[v]++
   104	    } else n["untagged"]++
   105	  }
   106	  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2
   110	
   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
   127	MODEL_CALLS=""
   128	if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# run-corpus.sh — replay tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl through the
     3	# block-destructive-bash hook and summarise (cycle-125 Sprint 1, PRD FR-1).
     4	#
     5	# Usage: run-corpus.sh [--hook PATH] [--corpus PATH] [--json]
     6	# Each row: {id, cmd, expect: allow|block|residual, rule, why, cwd: repo|tmp, env?: {TMPDIR}}
     7	#   allow    → benign: the hook must exit 0
     8	#   block    → dangerous: the hook must exit 2
     9	#   residual → accepted false positive: counted, never gated
    10	# Output (text): one line per mismatch, then "benign P/T dangerous B/T residual R/T runtime_ms N";
    11	# --json prints {benign_pass, benign_total, dangerous_block, dangerous_total,
    12	#   residual_pass, residual_total, runtime_ms, mismatches: [..]}.
    13	set -uo pipefail
    14	export LC_ALL=C
    15	root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../../.." && pwd)"
    16	hook="$root/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
    17	corpus="$root/tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/corpus.jsonl"
    18	json=0
    19	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    20	  case "$1" in
    21	    --hook) hook="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    22	    --corpus) corpus="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    23	    --json) json=1; shift ;;
    24	    *) echo "usage: run-corpus.sh [--hook PATH] [--corpus PATH] [--json]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    25	  esac
    26	done
    27	[[ -x "$hook" || -f "$hook" ]] || { echo "hook not found: $hook" >&2; exit 2; }
    28	[[ -f "$corpus" ]] || { echo "corpus not found: $corpus" >&2; exit 2; }
    29	
    30	work="$(mktemp -d)"
    31	trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
    32	repo="$work/repo"; scratch="$work/scratch"
    33	mkdir -p "$repo" "$scratch"
    34	export LOA_REPO_ROOT="$work"
    35	export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1   # audit rows this replay writes carry replay: true (cycle-129 DEC-0167)
    36	
    37	bp=0 bt=0 db=0 dt=0 rp=0 rt=0
    38	mismatches=()
    39	# Millisecond clock: $EPOCHREALTIME (bash ≥ 5) everywhere; GNU date fallback.
    40	now_ms() {
    41	  if [[ -n "${EPOCHREALTIME:-}" ]]; then
    42	    local s="${EPOCHREALTIME%.*}" us="${EPOCHREALTIME#*.}"
    43	    echo $(( s * 1000 + 10#${us:0:3} ))
    44	  else
    45	    echo $(( $(date +%s%N) / 1000000 ))
    46	  fi
    47	}
    48	start_ms=$(now_ms)
    49	while IFS= read -r row; do
    50	  [[ -n "$row" ]] || continue
    51	  id=$(jq -r '.id' <<<"$row"); cmd=$(jq -r '.cmd' <<<"$row"); expect=$(jq -r '.expect' <<<"$row")
    52	  cwd=$(jq -r '.cwd // "repo"' <<<"$row"); tmpdir=$(jq -r '.env.TMPDIR // empty' <<<"$row")
    53	  dir="$repo"; [[ "$cwd" == "tmp" ]] && dir="$scratch"
    54	  payload=$(jq -cn --arg c "$cmd" '{tool_input: {command: $c}}')
    55	  rc=0
    56	  if [[ -n "$tmpdir" ]]; then
    57	    (cd "$dir" && TMPDIR="$tmpdir" bash "$hook" <<<"$payload" >/dev/null 2>&1) || rc=$?
    58	  else
    59	    (cd "$dir" && env -u TMPDIR bash "$hook" <<<"$payload" >/dev/null 2>&1) || rc=$?
    60	  fi
    61	  case "$expect" in
    62	    allow)    bt=$((bt+1)); if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then bp=$((bp+1)); else mismatches+=("$id:expected-allow:rc=$rc"); fi ;;
    63	    block)    dt=$((dt+1)); if [[ $rc -eq 2 ]]; then db=$((db+1)); else mismatches+=("$id:expected-block:rc=$rc"); fi ;;
    64	    residual) rt=$((rt+1)); [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && rp=$((rp+1)) ;;
    65	    *) mismatches+=("$id:unknown-expect:$expect") ;;
    66	  esac
    67	done < "$corpus"
    68	end_ms=$(now_ms)
    69	runtime=$(( end_ms - start_ms ))
    70	
    71	if (( json )); then
    72	  printf '%s\n' "${mismatches[@]+"${mismatches[@]}"}" | jq -R . | jq -s \
    73	    --argjson bp "$bp" --argjson bt "$bt" --argjson db "$db" --argjson dt "$dt" \
    74	    --argjson rp "$rp" --argjson rt "$rt" --argjson ms "$runtime" \
    75	    '{benign_pass:$bp, benign_total:$bt, dangerous_block:$db, dangerous_total:$dt, residual_pass:$rp, residual_total:$rt, runtime_ms:$ms, mismatches: map(select(length>0))}'
    76	else
    77	  printf '%s\n' "${mismatches[@]+"${mismatches[@]}"}" | sed '/^$/d'
    78	  echo "benign $bp/$bt dangerous $db/$dt residual $rp/$rt runtime_ms $runtime"
    79	fi
